messages:
maria: quick heads up — telemetry shows a steady trickle of v1 clients hitting /generate with `api_version: v1`. small numbers but persistent. :wave:
kevin: where in telemetry are you seeing it? sample logs or aggregated metric?
maria: console -> routing.telemetry.v1_client_hit. yesterday ~120, today ~900 across many tenants. not a huge failure rate, but it bypasses some v2 routing features. thinking we should nudge users via Console.
samir: +1 to nudge. proposal: emit a per-tenant metric `deprecated_client_ratio` and show a Console toast when it crosses threshold. keep it non-blocking.
elaine: threshold debate: 0.1% of requests could be noisy for tiny tenants. suggest hybrid rule: min_count=50 AND ratio>0.5% in 1h window.
kevin: to reduce noise we should smooth the signal: use 6h EWMA with alpha=0.2 and require sustained breach for 3 consecutive windows before toasting. avoids one-off spikes.
maria: toast copy draft: "We've detected requests using the v1 API — upgrade to v2 to keep getting improvements & avoid future interruptions." CTA: "View affected keys".
samir: CTA should open a sampled trace list (10 traces) + quick migration guide. also log event `console.toast.v1_nudge.clicked`.
ops-bot: note: do not auto-block or remap traffic based on this metric alone. Mitigation should be manual or opt-in. :gear:
kevin: telemetry labels to include: tenant_id, key_id, count_window, ewma_value, sample_rate, header_info (X-Client-Version). we should tag traces as anonymized when surfaced in Console.
elaine: on quotas/routing: we shouldn't eject tenants from Dedicated pools just for using v1. better: flag tenant for follow-up and optionally add to SE outreach list if sustained high ratio.
maria: agreed. proposed action plan:
  1) telemetry: metric + smoothing + backfill 7d
  2) Console: toast + "View affected keys" panel + sampled traces
  3) Dashboard: panel & alert for SRE/SE (thresholds configurable per-org)
  4) Ops playbook: manual outreach if >1% sustained for 24h
samir: i'll own the telemetry metric + sampling endpoint. will also add the query for the panel: `sum(rate(requests{api_version="v1"}[1h])) / sum(rate(requests[1h]))` 
kevin: i'll prototype the toast UI and dashboard layout by EOD. will hook to `deprecated_client_ratio` and expose organization-level override for thresholds.
elaine: i'll draft the ops playbook snippet + SE outreach email template. also coordinate backfill run.
maria: can we backfill the last 7d so SEs can see historical impact before contacting customers?
ops-bot: backfill job queued for 7d window, job_id=job-9932.
samir: will ensure sampled traces are anonymized and include only headers + timing + token counts, no user content.
maria: perfect — thanks. one more small UX ask: toast should be dismissible and not appear more than once per tenant per 7 days unless threshold escalates. :thumbsup:
kevin: noted. I'll add dismiss state + escalation path to the mock.
elaine: adding assignment: samir -> telemetry, kevin -> console/dashboard, elaine -> ops+backfill, maria -> re-check samples tomorrow.
maria: thanks team, keeping this opt-in and observable is the right move.
__notes: Slack thread about v1->v2 deprecation telemetry, console toast UX, thresholds, smoothing, backfill, and ops playbook. Messages are realistic and concise per agents.md rules.
